hints.title: Longest Shared Subsequence
hints.text: A shortest supersequence keeps the longest common characters once and interleaves non-matching characters from both strings in order.

hints.title: Subproblem Grid
hints.text: Construct a two-dimensional grid finding the longest shared subsequence length, then trace backwards from the bottom-right corner to reconstruct the result.

hints.title: Backtracking Steps
hints.text: When characters match, add the character once and advance diagonally. When they differ, move toward the larger adjacent grid value while appending the corresponding character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all interleaved combinations yields exponential O(2^(M+N)) branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A 2D subproblem table of size (M+1) x (N+1) permits linear time path reconstruction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as the dual of the Longest Common Subsequence problem and reconstruct the sequence via backtracking.
complexity.notes: Final string contains both input strings as subsequences and achieves minimal possible length.
